translations.web: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
translations.bsb: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
translations.kjv: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded
translations.asv: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
